stemMd: Three filters have cost and expected lifetime as follows: P €18 for 6 months; Q €24 for 10 months; R €30 for 12 months. Ignoring replacement labour and discounting, which has the lowest cost per month?
explanationMd: Divide each price by its lifetime. P costs €3 per month, Q €2.40 and R €2.50. Q is cheapest per month even though P has the lowest purchase price and R the longest lifetime.

distractorRationale.d: Its monthly cost is €3, higher than the alternatives.
distractorRationale.c: Its monthly cost is €2.50, slightly above Q’s €2.40.
distractorRationale.e: Equal-looking increments in prices do not give equal monthly costs.
